Thanks for the idea! Please search existing issues and Discussions first — your

## Problem / motivation

What problem are you trying to solve? What's frustrating or missing today?
<!-- e.g. "I'm always frustrated when ..." -->

## Proposed solution

A clear and concise description of what you'd like to happen.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered, and why they fall short.

## Scope

<!-- Furx is open-core: the whole tree is Apache-2.0, but some paid features are
     gated by a runtime license check. See CONTRIBUTING.md. -->

- [ ] This is a **core** (free) capability.
- [ ] This relates to a paid tier (cloud sync / Cost-Router / Team / Enterprise).
- [ ] Not sure.

## Additional context

Mockups, links, prior art, or any other context that helps explain the request.
